name: Kisaragi Kyouko
source:
A high level woman in all aspects, who is also kind and has a slender body with beautifully shaped breasts! Normally, she has a serious mood around her as an office lady, but when she enters a hotel, she completely changes. 

She likes seducing or being seduced. Generally, she just likes sex. While exuding a bewitching charm, she passionately allures a man. Her first rate techniques are known to make most men captive to her touch.

[Translated and slightly edited from [url=http://herencia.nexton-net.jp/product/hitotsumami/character.html]Official Site[/url]]
